children: Truist disclosed a signed agreement to sell $5.5 billion of auto loans tied to Regional Acceptance, generating $5.2 billion of net proceeds and creating $945 million of CET1 capital.
Agreement to sell $5.5B of auto loans (substantially all Regional Acceptance assets); closing expected late 3Q26 or early 4Q26.
Transaction generates $5.2B net proceeds and $535M loan loss reserve recapture (difference between purchase price and loan amount net of reserve).
Creates $945M (22 bps) of CET1 capital driven by $410M after-tax reserve recapture and $600M RWA reduction, less $65M after-tax costs.
Reduces NPLs by >10 bps (as of 6/30/26) and lowers annual NCOs by ~10 bps; RAC pre-tax earnings were ~breakeven through six months ended 6/30/26.
Illustrative uses: repay wholesale borrowings and reposition AFS securities; 2026 outlook unchanged excluding strategic actions and $5B share repurchase target remains.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Truist to sell $5.5B in auto loans; $5.2B net proceeds boost CET1 by $945M
